intro: From the first research to the last ad set - one person who sees the whole picture and keeps every piece of it on brand.

items.title: Strategy
items.text: I dig into the brand, the audience and the competitors to find what the content should say and where.

items.title: SMM
items.text: I run social media end to end: content plans, feed, stories and captions that sound like the brand.

items.title: Design
items.text: I build visual systems for socials and design every piece inside them, from a post to an event poster.

items.title: Ads
items.text: I make ad creatives for different buying motives and run paid social campaigns that are built to be tested.

items.title: Video
items.text: I write, shoot and star in short-form video, with hooks that keep people watching past the first second.

items.title: AI content
items.text: I use AI to produce visuals and video that would be too slow or too costly to shoot.
